blindComparison: No source-blind reference comparison was conducted, and no stranger preference is asserted. These labelled production/unbatched diagnostic images cannot make any element satisfied.
verdictScope: Complete visual-readability and retained-roof coverage claims remain unsupported; this review found no definite new shadow-batching regression in the five inspected static views.

findings.problem: In this captured rooftop view, the head and upper body around x480..545/y275..365 merge into the almost black forward wall; arm pose and clothing outlines are hard to distinguish in both variants.
findings.why: The third-person character loses readable upper-body detail at this view. Lower legs remain silhouetted against the brighter floor, so the observation does not mean the whole character is invisible.
findings.fix: Investigate the lighting/material/camera contribution before changing it; recapture this exact view plus a supported roof view and require independently readable head/torso/arm boundaries while retaining the dark scene. Native images, not luma counters alone, must demonstrate the result.
findings.hypothesis: Mechanism unconfirmed. Identical batched/unbatched pixels refute attribution to this batching toggle; the observation does not establish whether light direction, surface normals, material response, or framing is the main cause.

observations.result: The current production image already has a dark shadow adjoining the feet and extending right. It is visually present without the separate forced-refresh capture, and cached/refreshed RGBA are identical here.
observations.scope: This static pose only; continuous moving shadow behaviour is not measured by these images.

observations.result: The previously identified AC block and three debris primitives are absent at their old projected locations in this view, consistent with the prior exact-geometry removal measurements.
observations.scope: This is not a claim that all city props are supported. The rusty vertical panel around x632..694/y134..254 remains visible and appears elevated, but no new support diagnosis has been established for it.

observations.result: marrow_roof looks toward a large dark forward wall. It does not visibly establish preservation of all retained pellroof/kettleroof/drayroof props; CPU support checks cannot be recast as their rendered visual verification.
observations.scope: The picture is a valid current rooftop scene and shadow comparison, but is insufficient to close the separate retained-dressing image coverage claim.
